title: PRISMA: open climate forecast verification, starting with Argentina
description:
PRISMA Climate is an open, independent scientific research codebase for archiving, verifying, and locally post-processing numerical weather and climate prediction ensembles against meteorological station observations in Argentina.

This release (v0.1.0) anchors the frozen evaluation protocol (docs/EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md) defining operational verification gates, local calibration methods (joint Gaussian EMOS minimizing mean continuous ranked probability score and empirical quantile mapping), and statistical decision rules (1000-resample moving-block bootstrap with block length 7 days). Operational forecast verification remains gated on archiving ≥ 15 distinct issue dates.
